# MRRDock

> Free, open-source macOS menu bar app that aggregates MRR (monthly recurring revenue)
> from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle Billing, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments, Gumroad
> and any custom HTTPS endpoint into a single total shown in the macOS menu bar.

- License: MIT. Price: free, no paid tier, no account.
- Requirements: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon or Intel (universal binary).
- Install: `brew install --cask simonsruggi/tap/mrrdock`, or download the notarized zip from GitHub Releases.
- Privacy: there is no MRRDock server. API keys are stored in the macOS Keychain, requests
  go only to the payment platforms you configure (plus Yahoo Finance for exchange rates).
  No account, no telemetry, no analytics.
- Per-platform coverage: Stripe (MRR, subs, trials, optional 28-day revenue), RevenueCat
  (MRR, subs, trials, 28-day revenue), Paddle Billing (MRR, subs, trials), Lemon Squeezy
  (MRR, subs, trials), Polar (MRR, subs, 28-day revenue), Dodo Payments (MRR, subs),
  Gumroad (28-day revenue only — its API exposes sales, not a priceable subscription ledger),
  custom HTTPS endpoint (everything you choose to return).
- MRR formula: unit_price × quantity × (intervals_per_month ÷ interval_count) × (1 − discount),
  with intervals_per_month 30.4375 daily, 4.348 weekly, 1 monthly, 1/12 yearly. Trials count
  as trials and contribute 0. Usage-based prices are flagged as "could not be priced", never guessed.
- Not a Baremetrics/ChartMogul replacement: no cohorts, LTV or churn forecasting by design.

## Pages
- [MRRDock home](https://mrrdock.simoneruggiero.com/): features, supported platforms, comparison with CatBar, IndieBar, Baremetrics and ChartMogul, FAQ, install instructions.
- [Documentation (README)](https://github.com/simonsruggi/MRRDock#readme): per-platform setup, API key scopes, MRR rules, troubleshooting.
- [Source code](https://github.com/simonsruggi/MRRDock): Swift / SwiftUI, no package dependencies.
- [Releases](https://github.com/simonsruggi/MRRDock/releases/latest): signed and notarized builds.
